verdict.rationale: Working Copy's manual documents a built-in Repository Agent, a conversational AI assistant that can browse, search, read and modify files, and commit, pull and push. The homepage separately advertises a 'Code Agent' alongside AI commit-message suggestions. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the agent (model choice, review or approval of changes, limits), independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Repository Agent is an AI assistant that you interact with through conversation. Ask it to browse files, search content, read and modify files, commit, pull and push.
Code Agent & commit suggestions. Respects your data with opt-in.
includes the ability to suggest messages using artificial intelligence.
